title: Scalable AI-Driven News Producer Network
subtitle: Automated podcast production pipeline generating multi-format content from news sources
seo_title: AI Podcast Production — Scalable Generative Audio Network
seo_description: Automated podcast production system using AI to generate, produce, and distribute multi-format audio content from curated news sources at scale.
thumb_alt: AI-driven podcast production pipeline showing automated news curation, script generation, and multi-format audio distribution
img_alt: Scalable podcast automation system with content pipeline visualization
challenge: Podcast production is labor-intensive — research, scripting, recording, editing, and distribution require significant human hours per episode. Scaling a podcast network traditionally means scaling production staff linearly. The challenge was building a system that could produce quality audio content at scale without proportional increases in human effort.
approach: Built an automated production pipeline that ingests curated news sources, generates editorial-quality scripts through AI analysis and summarization, produces multi-voice narration using text-to-speech synthesis, and distributes finished episodes across podcast platforms. The system handles the entire workflow from source discovery through published episode, with quality gates at each stage.
result: The system produces podcast episodes autonomously at a scale that would require a substantial production team to match manually. Content quality is maintained through structured editorial guidelines embedded in the AI pipeline. The architecture is horizontally scalable — adding new topic verticals or formats requires configuration changes, not additional staff.
